# Backlog Syntax

> Backlog open source e multi-tenant para coordenar pessoas e agentes por REST, OpenAPI e MCP.

## Main pages
- /: product status and architecture summary
- /documentacao: public API, remote MCP, WebMCP, authorization and concurrency guide
- /transparencia: current product and data-processing status
- /privacidade: privacy notice, providers and data-subject rights

This file is a low-cost discovery aid. It does not replace the website, README, or public documentation.
